_comment: Schema for ST-GCN training label JSONL files. Each line in a .jsonl file under data/labels/ must match this shape.

video_path.description: Path to source video relative to project root, or R2 key if remote

fault_label.description: Primary fault. 'none' means technically sound stroke.

segment_start_frame.description: 0-indexed frame number where the stroke swing begins (optional, used to override auto-segmentation)

segment_end_frame.description: 0-indexed frame number where the stroke swing ends (optional)

annotator.description: Who labeled this record (professor, auto, or annotator name)

example_record.notes: Classic arm-only pattern, hip barely moves
